Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Visionary Optical Services LLC specializes in providing a wide range of optical goods and services, including the sale of eyewear, contact lenses, and optical accessories. Our operations encompass comprehensive eye examinations and personalized fittings conducted by licensed optometrists and opticians, ensuring compliance with state regulations. We emphasize quality customer service, with a focus on helping clients find the best vision solutions tailored to their needs. Additionally, we have strict protocols for inventory management and employee conduct to prevent dishonesty and maintain compliance. Our services are supported by advanced optical technology and equipment, all maintained in accordance with industry standards to minimize operational disruptions.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Employee Dishonesty Reporting: Any suspected or confirmed employee dishonesty or
inventory shrinkage must be reported to the insurer promptly (within 72 hours) to maintain
coverage eligibility and enable timely investigation.
• Restriction on Use of Unlicensed Contact Lens Fitting Services: Optical businesses
offering contact lens fitting must ensure all practitioners are properly licensed and comply
with state regulations. Coverage excludes claims arising from unlicensed fitting or dispensing
of contact lenses, due to heightened professional liability exposure and regulatory scrutiny.
Preferred Optional Coverages
• Business Interruption: Covers loss of income and extra expenses resulting from covered
perils that disrupt normal operations, such as fire damage to retail premises or lab equipment
breakdown.
• Cyber and Equipment Breakdown: Cyber coverage protects against data breaches and
cyber extortion, while equipment breakdown coverage addresses costly repairs or replacement
